column1: SE Variable Incentive Policy — FY26-27 (6-Month Cycle) — Source: Variable Incentive Policy FY 26-27

Only the SE-applicable section of the policy is extracted here (ABM/RBM/State/National/Cattle Feed sections excluded). Status for every row is Policy Reference (Fixed) — sourced from a signed company document, not a config choice.

column4: Four weighted parameters make up the SE's 6-month Weighted Performance Score (WPS): Revenue 25% · Collection 30% · Product Mix 25% · Farmers Activity 20%
column7: SE Daily Planner Agent can show the SE how today's actions move each of these four incentive levers, not just today's BO grade

column4: Net Sales = AOP GMV Target vs. Achievement on invoices after returns. GMV target = PL + specialised fertiliser (Urea Shakti, Prom) + TM (Brand+PL). If achievement <60%: Revenue score = 0 AND Product Mix score = 0. 6-month cumulative, capped at 200%.
column5: Revenue_% = MIN(Invoiced_Sales_After_Returns ÷ AOP_GMV_Target, 2.00); IF Revenue_% < 0.60 THEN Revenue_Score = 0 AND ProductMix_Score = 0
column7: The <60% cliff-edge zeroes TWO parameters at once (Revenue and Product Mix) — agent should treat an SE approaching this line as an urgent flag, since it's a double hit

column4: Rewards higher-margin product sales. Each product pre-scored A=4/B=3/C=2/D=1. Mix Score = weighted average of product scores by % contribution to achievement. Cattle feed excluded from calc; Urea Shakti & TM(Brand+PL) included; definition per AOP.
column5: Mix_Score = Σ(Product_Score × Contribution_%); Achievement = IF(Mix_Score>3,150%,IF(Mix_Score≥2.5,120%,IF(Mix_Score≥2,100%,IF(Mix_Score≥1.5,50%,0%)))); forced to 0% if Revenue_% < 0.60
column7: Ties BO1's PL grade to real incentive payout — agent explaining a PL recommendation can note its Product Mix score impact, not just the BO1 grade

column4: OD% = Overdue as of eval date ÷ last 12 months' sales. Final exit measured at H1 (30 Sept) and H2 (31 Mar). If OD > 10%, the SE's ENTIRE final payout slab (not just this parameter) is capped at 70%.
column5: OD_% = Outstanding_Overdue ÷ Sales_Trailing_12M; Collection_Achievement = IF(OD_%>0.10,0%,IF(OD_%≥0.06,60%,IF(OD_%≥0.04,80%,IF(OD_%≥0.02,100%,IF(OD_%≥0.01,150%,200%))))); IF OD_%>0.10 THEN Final_Payout_% = MIN(Final_Payout_%, 70%)
column7: The whole-payout 70% cap at OD>10% is the single highest-stakes trigger in this policy — agent should proactively surface any SE whose OD is trending toward 10%, tied to BO3 and the existing 3.7 order-block safety rule

column4: Minimum 12 mega-farmer meetings per SE in 6 months (=2/month), min 50 farmers per meeting — both conditions must be met. If fewer than 8 meetings in 6 months, score = 0 (hard floor). Achievement capped at 100% (no over-achievement bonus, unlike other parameters).
column5: Meetings_Per_Month_Target = 2; Min_Attendees = 50; IF Meetings_6M < 8 THEN Score = 0; Achievement = MIN(Meetings_Held ÷ 12, 100%)
column6: Matches BO5 exactly (2 Mega meetings/month, 50+ attendee threshold)
column7: Confirms BO5's config is correctly aligned with the incentive policy — good cross-check, no conflict found

column4: WPS mapped to a payout percentage on a fixed slab, before any OD>10% cap is applied.
column7: Useful for the SE Daily Planner Agent to translate a day's plan into an expected payout-slab impact, if desired as a motivational framing

column4: New joinee: first 3 months = 100% achievement. Transfer cases: first 3 months = 100%. Variable paid half-yearly. AOP targets are the sole criterion. SE leaving after quarter-end still gets that quarter's payout at final calc. Any compliance issue against the employee puts the variable on hold until resolved. SE-wise AOP targets are set from the SE's active DC count over the trailing 12 months.
column5: N/A — administrative rules, not a scoring formula
column6: Active-DC-count basis links directly to DC master + BO2 coverage data
column7: Agent should treat 'compliance hold' and 'new joinee / transfer grace period' as account-level flags that suppress or float-fix a plan's incentive framing, sourced from HR data rather than sales data

column4: Financial-impact quality issues adjust the following quarter's calculation. Threshold: ₹50L+ impact in UP, BH, MP, MH, WB, JH; ₹25L+ impact in RJ, OD, HR, GJ, CH.
column5: IF Quality_Impact_Value ≥ State_Threshold(state) THEN Adjust_Next_Quarter_Calc = TRUE, State_Threshold = 50L for {UP,BH,MP,MH,WB,JH}, 25L for {RJ,OD,HR,GJ,CH}
column6: Matches the gap flagged in Section 9.3 of the BO questionnaire ("Quality issue" named as a missing BO)
column7: Confirms the business's own 9.3 answer — recommend scoping a BO6 (Quality) objective now that a real threshold and state list exist to build it from
